correctness.rationale: Every path from the first Poisson seed covers by radius 1/2; antipodal thinning has exact H mean 5/4−e^(−1/4). Exact Poisson voids at 1/2, 3/8, 5/8 give integrated two-arc union exponents and an inclusion–exclusion lower bound. Signed Taylor bounds certify E H_Haar≥29716847/62914560 and E H_antipodal≤181/384; exact subtraction is 61807/62914560>0. A coupling with per-mark recoloring probability 1/1024 changes expected time by at most 3/4096, yielding the full-support gap 15727/62914560>0. Exact rational checker confirms both integrals and inequalities; probabilistic lemmas are proved in RESULT.md.
